title: Amazon Nuke Deal Fuels Constellation Energy After Axed Data Center
title_zh: Amazon Nuke Deal Fuels Constellation Energy After Axed Data Center
summary: Amazon announced a 20-year nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy late Wednesday. The deal will enable expansion at the Maryland nuclear plant where the e-commerce giant just scrapped plans to build a data center in August, amid community opposition.

title: What Could Morgan Stanley (MS) Merger Talks Mean For Investors?
title_zh: What Could Morgan Stanley (MS) Merger Talks Mean For Investors?
summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) is reportedly exploring a potential merger or combination with UBS AG under pressure from Swiss regulators. Swiss authorities are said to be urging UBS to reinforce its capital position, prompting discussions with several large foreign banks.

title: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition
title_zh: Salesforce up 3.2% after announcing Listen Labs acquisition
summary: Shares of Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM, XETRA:FOO) were up 3.2% on Wednesday after the company signed a definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs, an AI-powered customer research and human simulation platform.
